criterionAssessments.rationale: Single API + credit dashboard is the easiest entry in the cluster for developers. Not a lab test.
Managed scraping API fits web-data-collection — not a full enterprise proxy estate peer of Bright Data.
JS rendering, CAPTCHA/anti-bot, crawler access, and DataPipeline cover common scrape loops; less proxy-type depth.
Language SDKs and HTTP API are enough for most scrape pipelines.
SMB/mid-market SaaS posture — weaker published enterprise compliance story than Oxylabs ISO 27001.
Plans scale to 20M+ credits and Enterprise custom — concurrency caps apply.
Free + $49 Hobby floor is the clearest low-entry path; domain multipliers are the catch. Affiliate economics excluded.
No meaningful AI copilot story versus Actor platforms — scored low.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
